name: Exp_JBrainTrend1Stop
summary: This EA trades based on the JBrainTrend1Stop custom indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend and sell positions when it signals a downtrend. It uses ATR and Stochastic oscillator inputs combined with JMA smoothing to determine trend direction and stop levels. Position sizing is configurable via money management modes, and trades are managed with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于JBrainTrend1Stop自定义指标进行交易，在指标发出上升趋势信号时开多仓，在发出下降趋势信号时开空仓。它结合ATR和随机振荡器参数以及JMA平滑来确定趋势方向和止损水平。仓位大小可通过资金管理模式配置，交易使用可配置的止损和止盈进行管理。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用JBrainTrend1Stop指标作为核心策略引擎，该指标结合ATR（平均真实范围）和随机振荡器（Stochastic）来判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当上升趋势缓冲区有值且下降趋势缓冲区前一值为非零时开多仓；当下降趋势缓冲区有值且上升趋势缓冲区前一值为非零时开空仓。出场条件通过反向信号触发平仓，同时配合可配置的止损和止盈来控制风险。仓位管理支持五种模式：基于可用保证金、基于余额、基于扣除亏损后的可用保证金、基于扣除亏损后的余额、以及固定手数。策略仅在检测到新K线时执行信号判断，避免重复交易。止损设为1000点，止盈设为2000点，风险回报比为1:2，较为合理。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the JBrainTrend1Stop indicator as its core strategy engine, which combines ATR (Average True Range) and Stochastic oscillator to determine trend direction. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the uptrend buffer has a value and the downtrend buffer's previous value was non-zero; a sell position opens when the downtrend buffer has a value and the uptrend buffer's previous value was non-zero. Exit conditions are triggered by opposing trend signals that close existing positions, supplemented by configurable stop loss and take profit levels for risk control. Position sizing supports five modes: based on free margin, balance, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. The strategy only evaluates signals on new bar detection, preventing redundant trades within the same bar. The default stop loss is set to 1000 points and take profit to 2000 points, yielding a 1:2 risk-reward ratio which is reasonable.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理百分比或固定手数
parameters.description_en: Money management percentage or fixed lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 资金管理模式（可用保证金/余额/扣除亏损后可用保证金/扣除亏损后余额/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Money management mode (free margin/balance/free margin after loss/balance after loss/fixed lot)

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于趋势跟踪原则，使用ATR和随机振荡器组合判断趋势方向
提供灵活的资金管理模式，支持五种不同的仓位计算方式
具备新K线检测机制，避免同一根K线内重复开仓
止损止盈比例合理（1:2），风险回报比适中
允许独立控制多空方向的开仓和平仓，灵活性高
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on trend following principles, using ATR and Stochastic combination for trend direction detection
Flexible money management with five different position sizing modes
New bar detection mechanism prevents redundant trade entries within the same bar
Reasonable stop loss to take profit ratio (1:2), providing a balanced risk-reward profile
Independent control over buy/sell opening and closing directions offers high flexibility
cons: 高度依赖自定义指标JBrainTrend1Stop，指标逻辑不透明，黑盒风险较高
默认止损1000点和止盈2000点数值偏大，可能不适合所有品种和波动环境
缺少点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下可能产生不利入场
信号基于已收盘K线（SignalBar=1），存在延迟入场问题
未包含移动止损或追踪止损功能，无法锁定浮动利润
cons_en: Heavy reliance on the custom JBrainTrend1Stop indicator whose internal logic is opaque, creating black-box risk
Default SL of 1000 points and TP of 2000 points are large values that may not suit all instruments and volatility environments
No spread filter mechanism, potentially leading to unfavorable entries in high-spread conditions
Signals are based on closed bars (SignalBar=1), causing delayed entry
No trailing stop functionality to lock in floating profits as the trade moves favorably
improvements: 增加点差过滤，当点差超过阈值时不执行交易，避免不利入场
添加移动止损（Trailing Stop）功能，在趋势延续时锁定更多利润
增加对JBrainTrend1Stop指标加载失败的更完善错误处理和重试机制
improvements_en: Add a spread filter to avoid trading when the spread exceeds a threshold, preventing unfavorable entries
Implement a trailing stop feature to lock in more profits as the trend continues in favor
Improve error handling and add retry logic for JBrainTrend1Stop indicator loading failures

risk_points: 依赖黑盒自定义指标，指标内部逻辑不可审查，可能存在不可预期的行为
默认止损1000点较大，在低波动品种上可能承受过多不必要的风险
未检查当前持仓状态，可能在已有同方向持仓时重复开仓
risk_points_en: Reliance on a black-box custom indicator whose internal logic cannot be audited for unexpected behavior
The default 1000-point stop loss is large and may expose unnecessary risk on low-volatility instruments
No check for existing positions in the same direction, potentially leading to duplicate entries

It uses ATR and Stochastic oscillator inputs combined with JMA smoothing to determine trend direction and stop levels. Position sizing is configurable via money management modes, and trades are managed with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
